notes.title: Bug Fix #5 - Better Boundaries
notes.notes: Okay boundaries should be 100% impossible to get out of now

notes.title: Bug Fix #4 - Tighter Boundaries
notes.notes: Should be much harder to get out of bounds and once you are, you should be immediately snapped back in bounds.

notes.title: Bug Fix #3 - Double Death patch
notes.notes: Dying twice in one frame was desyncing player stats, causing them to potentially trigger the anti-cheat as an invalid score.

notes.title: Leaderboard bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed issue with the Friends leaderboard showing your global ranking instead of your ranking among friends
